title: TSAI Key-Binding JWT Claims Set
description: The claims set of the key-binding JWT a holder appends when presenting a TSAI credential. The JWT header carries typ kb+jwt. The signature is made with the private key matching the credential's cnf. Per RFC 9901 §4.3, iat, aud, nonce and sd_hash are required.

aud.description: The Service Provider HTTPS origin the presentation is addressed to

nonce.description: Agent-generated at baseline (>=128 bits, fresh per presentation) or Service-Provider-issued on escalation

sd_hash.description: Digest over the issuer-signed JWT and forwarded disclosures, per RFC 9901 §4.3.1

req.description: Optional request binding (ADR 020); required for state-changing actions where the verifying and acting components differ

digest.description: Content digest of the request body per RFC 9530
